name: Kirimura Yuka
source:
A servant of the Hinagami family. Her family has been devoted to the Hinagami family since her mother’s generation. She’s a year younger than [url=/c11248]Ayato[/url] and [url=/c11239]Karen[/url] and loves them as if they were her own siblings. 

She looks meek and young, but she’s very dependable. She handles cooking, laundry, cleaning, and all other housework without flaw. 

"Well, I have to prepare dinner, so I’ll be going."

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
